idea.title: What a payments internship teaches you that a LeetCode streak cannot
idea.angle: Argue that owning one boring, money-touching system (retries, refunds, reconciliation) is stronger interview evidence than more solved problems, as interviews shift towards project reasoning.
idea.why_now: Reporting in 2026 describes SWE interviews moving from memorised algorithm drills towards project reasoning and workflow evidence.
idea.experience_hook: The writer's part-time payments engineering work and how they now describe it to recruiters.
